description.value: A Taco Bell fast-food location on Granville Street in Vancouver serving Tex-Mex staples including tacos, burritos, and Crunchwrap Supremes. The restaurant offers indoor seating with air conditioning, making it a reasonable stop for cyclists needing a quick, filling meal in a busy urban corridor. A dedicated vegetarian menu is available alongside the standard lineup.
